items.extracted_excerpt: Kimi K3.1 Pro is available in Vercel Token Pass. Use Moonshot AI’s model for coding and agentic workflows with vision, tool use, and a 1M-token context window.
items.extracted_text_for_analysis: Token Pass now includes Kimi K3.1 Pro, Moonshot AI’s most capable model for coding and agentic workflows, with vision, tool use, and a 1M context window. Token Pass is an Early Access subscription for Pro teams that includes Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, GLM 5.3 Flash, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, with more models to come. For $30 per team per month, you get $150 in monthly credit to use in coding agents connected to AI Gateway, including fx, Pi, Cline, and Command Code, as well as agents you build with the AI SDK. Requests served through Token Pass have zero data retention. Subscribe on the Token Pass page in your team's AI Gateway dashboard, then select moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro in your connected agent's model picker. Contributors Reference Architecture Choose a stack and work through the decisions behind it, with curated documentation, guides, templates, and courses to help you build. - Agent stack: Build and operate agents with models, tools, and durable workflows. - Web applications: Choose rendering, data, authentication, and caching approaches. - Backends: Choose a runtime, connect services, and run background work.
